title: Grateful Dead Live at Universal Amphitheatre on 1973-06-30
lineage: Master Reel > Reel >Dat > WAV > FLAC (Reel labeled: through the Debbie connection: P.A.  Harmon Kardon; probably recorded from the soundboard)

ai_review.summary: Excellent audience recording captures a high‑energy summer ’73 set with standout “Eyes of the World”, solid second‑set flow and classic favorites like “Cumberland Blues” and “Sugar Magnolia”.
ai_review.review: The taper’s cleanup work makes this audience tape sound unusually clear—better than most Dead auds on the archive. The show itself is a quintessential summer ’73 performance, highlighted by a blazing “Eyes of the World”, a tight second set, and reliable renditions of “Cumberland Blues” and “Sugar Magnolia”.

ai_rating.rationale: All three reviews are strongly positive (4–5 stars) and praise both the recording’s clarity and the show’s energy, indicating a high‑quality performance captured on an excellent audience tape.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Taper cleaned up the source; sound is clear, well‑balanced with low noise—described as better than 99% of other Dead audience recordings.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Solid, flowing set with a strong second‑set; classic mid‑summer ’73 vibe keeps momentum high throughout.
